kind: captioned guide assembled from saved rehearsal captures
limitations: Not a recording of live user interactions
Recorded final agent comparison tied at 6/6

scenes.title: Read the passenger's request
scenes.caption: This is a simulated booking from the pinned tau-bench data. Change the outward flight, keep the return, and obtain confirmation before writing.

scenes.title: Understand the booking API
scenes.caption: The update replaces the whole flight list. A successful call does not establish that the list still contains every flight the passenger wanted.

scenes.title: Inspect a real tool error
scenes.caption: This saved discovery run contains a reservation-read timeout. Read the arguments and error in Agent Lens. No booking change had occurred at this point.

scenes.title: Follow the recovery
scenes.caption: The next read succeeded. The same conversation ultimately passed its booking checks. An error span alone would mislabel this request as an unresolved failure.

scenes.title: Check whether Insights is available
scenes.caption: The prepared project had no completed native clustering run at qualification. This diagram explains the intended investigation; it is not a screenshot of a completed cluster.

scenes.title: Scope and save the monitoring rule
scenes.caption: The recorded tag targets one workshop agent. Its criteria ask whether a change was unrequested, rather than counting flights. Participants create a separate tag in their own project.

scenes.title: Separate the review from the judge result
scenes.caption: Expected result is the human review. Native Alignment tests returned HTTP 500 and supplied no judge outcome. Precision and recall cannot be claimed from these saved labels alone.

scenes.title: Keep unprocessed turns visible
scenes.caption: A missing live tag can mean the turn is unprocessed or the judge was unavailable. Do not count it as a correct negative. Coverage and agreement use different denominators.

scenes.title: Turn a reviewed event into a test
scenes.caption: Save the original booking, request, policy, expected behavior, and source turn. Replaying only the final booking would test the aftermath instead of reproducing the incident.

scenes.title: Preserve flights outside the requested range
scenes.caption: The repair keeps the prefix and suffix around the replaced range. The local omission drill demonstrates this repair. It is separate from the actual model's live behavior.

scenes.title: Compare matching requests in EvalTables
scenes.caption: The native development comparison aligns four requests per version. Both versions passed all four. Open a row to inspect its booking state and trace before explaining a score.

scenes.title: Report the observed tie
scenes.caption: The recorded final comparison passed six of six requests for both versions. Subsequent traffic passed four of four for both. The rehearsal does not establish a live quality improvement.

scenes.title: Save the conclusion and stop automatic judging
scenes.caption: Publish the saved comparisons and your conclusion, then verify that automatic tagging is off. The workshop remains a technical preview until native access and participant rehearsal pass.
